title: J001: Add Go mock Central API server with fixtures
description:
**Size:** 🏗️ large
**Category:** testing
**Priority:** critical
**Source:** Proposed for 'After binary builds, Docker image builds, etc. are now in place'

Create a standalone Go mock server at test/e2e/mockapi/ using net/http (no frameworks). Implements 7 endpoints: GET /v1/ping (health), POST /v1/register (returns fixture node_id, mesh_ip, peers), POST /v1/nodes/{id}/heartbeat (returns reconcile:true), GET /v1/nodes/{id}/state (returns fixture peers, policies), GET /v1/nodes/{id}/metadata (returns fixture metadata blob), GET /v1/nodes/{id}/events (SSE stream with keep-alive), and GET /test/assertions (returns JSON call counters). Uses atomic counters for registration, heartbeat, metadata, and state calls. Includes a Dockerfile for the mock server. Fixture response shapes must match plexd's actual API client types found in internal/ packages. Add unit tests for the mock server verifying each endpoint returns correct fixtures and counters increment properly.

**Rationale:** This is the foundation for all three E2E test jobs. Without a mock Central API, plexd cannot execute its real registration, heartbeat, metadata fetch, and reconciliation flows in CI. Currently there is zero validation that plexd actually works against a running API server.

**Affected Areas:**
- test/e2e/mockapi/main.go
- test/e2e/mockapi/Dockerfile
- test/e2e/mockapi/main_test.go
- internal/

review_criteria: All 7 mock endpoints (ping, register, heartbeat, state, metadata, events, assertions) return correct HTTP status codes and fixture data
Fixture response JSON shapes are verified wire-compatible with internal/api types (RegisterResponse, HeartbeatResponse, StateResponse) via unmarshal tests
All atomic counters (registration, heartbeat, state, metadata) are tested for correctness under concurrent access with -race flag
SSE endpoint correctly streams keep-alive comments with proper Content-Type and handles client disconnect without goroutine leaks
Mock server uses only net/http standard library — no external HTTP frameworks
Dockerfile produces a minimal image using multi-stage build with scratch or distroless runtime
All unit tests pass with go test -race -count=1 ./test/e2e/mockapi/
Code follows project conventions: package doc comment, exported types have doc comments, error format matches 'package: context: detail' pattern
implementation_notes: The mock server lives at test/e2e/mockapi/ as a standalone main package within the plexd module. Since it's inside the module, it can import internal/api types directly for wire compatibility verification in tests. The server uses http.NewServeMux (Go 1.22+ pattern-based routing with {id} wildcards). Atomic counters use sync/atomic.Int64 (Go 1.19+). The SSE handler uses http.Flusher for streaming and context.Done() for disconnect detection. Keep-alive interval is 15 seconds matching typical proxy timeout thresholds. The Dockerfile follows the same multi-stage pattern as deploy/docker/Dockerfile but produces a simpler image since the mock server has no runtime dependencies. The listen address defaults to :8080 and is configurable via -addr flag or MOCK_API_ADDR environment variable (flag takes precedence). Path parameter extraction for {id} uses Go 1.22's http.Request.PathValue() method. No external dependencies are added to go.mod — the mock server uses only the standard library plus internal/api types.
